notes: TBox replace of the circle area rule (πr² to 2πr²). The answers are fol: Z3 checks all three queries. The class axiom is encoded here for the structural check only.

queries.not_checked: fol (arithmetic): an area from a radius

fol.notes: The area of a circle (or figure) of radius r is the model's belief, an uninterpreted function of r; the rule is instantiated for the two radii the questions use (4 and 1). π is a constant pinned to 14 decimal places, so the multiples of π the answers name are single values (the answers' choices spell them as numbers).

local.circle_area: the area of a figure of radius r, as the model believes it (record-local rule)
